text: You just finished your fourth energy drink, and your heart is pounding.
One can can have up to three hundred milligrams of caffeine.
The FDA says about four hundred a day is the limit for most adults. You're way past it.
Caffeine blocks the chemical that makes you tired, so your body stays on high alert.
Your heart races, your blood pressure climbs, and your hands start to shake.
Chug around twelve hundred milligrams fast, and it can cause seizures.
And it lasts. Half of it is still in you five hours later.
Tag the friend who lives on energy drinks, and subscribe.
